meaning: Authored orthographic shell study. Positive z faces viewer. Depth units are reference pixels, not real dimensions. Full territories develop the narrow courses; shell backs provide explicit hidden return surfaces. This is an interpretation, not reconstructed physical threads.
seamExpansion: One grid cell of neighbouring territory support, restricted to actual material vertices. This expands geometry at joins rather than painting gaps shut.

recesses.resolution: retain crown material as rounded recess; no through-opening inferred
retain lower material as rounded recess; visible returning strokes support a surface

hiddenReturns: Each shell includes a geometric back and boundary walls. A continuous closed course follows the visible guide, a rounded depth turn at its end, the back guide with reversed u, and a rounded return to its start. This is an authored continuation model, not recovered strand identity. Individual thread turns need Step 4 development; no automatic inter-bundle joins.
limits: Conservative grid discretization leaves a small boundary margin. Gaps larger than that are measured. Oblique view exposes separated shells and may require later depth refinement; do not treat it as the reference's actual hidden sculpture.
